primitives.note: Mark consumption on next basic attack against a marked target deals flat + %maxHP physical damage as a proc after the attack lands
P's All Out bonus converts K'Sante's own bonus armor/MR into extra %maxHP damage; R's lethality converts a share of K'Sante's target's bonus armor into penetration
Hitting with Q grants a stack (6s, refreshes, caps at 2); at 2 stacks the next Q cast is empowered and consumes them

Q's empowered form is a distinct effect gated by stacks; W is charge-then-recast with a separate damage/true-damage formula per charge length; R has a near-end strike plus a second terrain-emergence strike if terrain is involved
Ntofo Strikes resets K'Sante's basic attack timer on cast
Path Maker channels 0.4-1s (damage/true-damage/stun scale with channel length) before its automatic or manual recast; charge cannot be interrupted by CC
All Out (15s): bonus attack speed, 50% bonus-armor penetration (lethality), 20% omnivamp, free-cost basic abilities
Flat bonus attack speed percent granted for the All Out duration
Q's cooldown scales down with K'Sante's bonus resistances and is cut 33% in All Out; W's cooldown is fully refreshed on entering All Out; E's cooldown is halved in All Out
Mana costs on Q/W/E/R; entering All Out restores 100% mana and makes Q/W/E free for its duration, mana then decays back to the pre-cast amount
Q and W scale off the target's max health and K'Sante's own bonus armor/MR; R's strike scales off K'Sante's own bonus health
R deals a second (near-doubled) damage instance only if the target is pulled through valid terrain; a dummy fight has no terrain to test this against

All Out imposes a non-exceedable/non-restorable current-health ceiling at 65% max health and slashes base armor/MR by 85% of bonus armor/MR — relevant chiefly to the survival fight if K'Sante is the tanky defender
Footwork deals no damage; it is a pure mobility/shield tool relevant only to damage taken in the survival fight

needsBespoke.why: K'Sante's damage output is governed by feedback loops the primitive list cannot express as independent pieces: (1) R's All Out simultaneously slashes K'Sante's own base armor/MR and imposes a health ceiling while ALSO empowering Q/W's damage (which itself scales off K'Sante's own bonus armor/MR) and P's mark bonus (which scales off K'Sante's own bonus armor/MR) — so the caster's own stat state must be tracked and re-derived mid-fight rather than treated as a flat self-buff; (2) P's All Out bonus explicitly amplifies an existing damage instance rather than adding a new one, and only ever applies to the first target of a multi-target hit, which is a multiplicative-not-additive rule not covered by onhit-rider/stat-conversion alone; (3) R's damage is genuinely conditional on unmodeled terrain geometry, producing either one or two separate physical damage instances of different magnitude; (4) Q's live cooldown is itself a function of the build's bonus resistances (a dynamic, resistance-driven cooldown-reduction formula, not a fixed per-rank cooldown), which interacts with mana budget and attack-reset timing all at once.
